config.method: CCS-guided confidence resampling, SGD warmup, then evolution-strategy LoRA refinement using swap-consistency as fitness

summary: Using Contrastive Consistency Search to find an unsupervised truth direction in the strong model's hidden states, then resampling training data by confidence agreement and refining LoRA parameters with a gradient-free evolution strategy guided by swap-consistency, this approach reached a PGR of 0.93 aggregated across 16 seeds on the chat preference testbed.
source: Wen, Qiu, et al., 'Automated Weak-to-Strong Researcher', Anthropic Alignment Science Blog, 2026
